--------
CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH  --------
For the Petitioner(s) : Mr. Anjani Kumar, Advocate For the State : Mr. Sudhir Kumar Mahto, A.P. P.
 --------
04/ Dated 10.12.2024  Heard the parties.

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Anandpur P.S. Case No. 22 of 2023, Spl.
POCSO Case No.07 of 2024, for the offences registered under Sections 366-A, 376(2)(n), 376-D,
376-B & 506 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 4 & 6 of POCSO Act, thereafter, the charge has been framed under Sections 363, 376(DB), 506 & 342 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 6 of POCSO Act, pending in the court of Sri Santosh Anand Prasad, learned Spl. Judge, POCSO Act Cases, West Singhbhum at Chaibasa.
Petitioner alongwith co-accused persons are alleged to have raped the victim, who is a minor girl.
It was submitted that the statements of the victim and her father have been recorded during trial and they have not supported the prosecution case.
It was further submitted that similarly situated co-accused Dharamdeo Kachhap has been granted bail by this Court earlier.
Considering the aforesaid fact, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of Sri Santosh Anand Prasad, learned Spl. Judge, POCSO Act Cases, West Singhbhum at Chaibasa, in connection with Anandpur P.S. Case No. 22 of 2023, Spl. POCSO Case No.07 of 2024.
